title: 低い桶は、嘘をつかない
state: 160L桶は独立した丈夫な架台。配水は最初、一列ずつ容器で量を測る。細い自動点滴を既製品として出さない。

dialogue: 水を運ぶだけで、午前が終わる。
仕込みにも、来てほしい。
scenes.description: Kou carries two manageable wooden water buckets along path, not over crop bed; small closeup blistered palm; Elna at diner kitchen doorway worried about empty prep table. Seedlings small, daytime.

dialogue: 桶を上げれば、流れるよ。
scenes.description: Iris enters beside empty wooden tank and laid-out ceramic pipe segments; medium Kou faces her, lower her hand sketches tank above beds. Goggles on forehead, navy short hair. No modern PVC or electronics.

Three practical construction panels: Iris checks tank and support sketch, Kou and Balt assemble braced thick timber free-standing platform, Elna sees strong diagonal bracing. Water tank is still empty until stand complete. Do not place 160kg on flimsy roof.

dialogue: 高さと、管の長さが違うから。
scenes.description: Three unequal closeups same elapsed test: different outlets pour into identical measuring cups, near cup contains more than far cup; lower Kou and Iris looking at difference. Tank only modest height, pipe has clear joints and accessible valves.

dialogue: 一列ずつ開けて、量を測る。
壊れても、直せる形にしよう。
scenes.description: Iris points to simple wooden stopcock, Kou opens ONE bed section and measures delivered water; other sections closed. Hands and pipe physically coherent. Main outlet larger than tiny modern drip emitter.

Two closeups and one face panel: removable mesh filter lifted from accessible housing, Elna rinses removable part in utility basin, Iris shows simple fitting. Irrigation tool cleaning not on food-prep surface.

dialogue: 魔法は、桶に上げる時だけ。
scenes.description: Tall composition: small water spell lifts EXISTING water from source barrel to raised tank, luminous blue stream visibly connects both water bodies, source level falls; then valve sends stored water gently to one section while Iris lowers hand exhausted but satisfied. No conjured infinite water.

dialogue: 空いた時間で、苗を見る。
それから、昼ごはんを作ろう。
scenes.description: Large warm scene: Kou crouches inspecting SMALL seedlings, water delivery controlled in one background section; lower Elna invites him at blue-awning diner, still modest plot, no broad mature crop. His hands relaxed.
